{{Short description|Romanian mathematician}}
'''Florian Luca''' (16 March 1969 – 28 July 2026<ref>{{cite web |last=Iana |first=Ciprian |title=A murit Florian Luca, reputat profesor de matematică. Nicușor Dan: „Sunt uluit! Am fost colegi de cameră la lot, în 1985” |url=https://www.libertatea.ro/stiri/florian-luca-a-murit-matematician-reactie-nicusor-dan-5836736 |website=Libertatea |language=ro |date=1 August 2026 |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://hub.williams.edu/math/the-passing-of-professor-florian-luca/ |publisher=[[Williams College]] |website=hub.williams.edu |title=The Passing of Professor Florian Luca}}</ref>) was a [[Romania]]n mathematician who specialized in [[number theory]] with emphasis on [[Diophantine equation]]s, [[recurrence relation|linear recurrences]] and the distribution of values of [[arithmetic function]]s. He made notable contributions to the proof that irrational automatic numbers are transcendental and the proof of a conjecture of [[Paul Erdős]] on the intersection of the [[Euler Totient function]] and the [[Divisor function|sum of divisors function]].

Luca was born in [[Galați]] and graduated with a BS in Mathematics from [[Alexandru Ioan Cuza University]] in [[Iași]] (1992), and Ph.D. in Mathematics from the [[University of Alaska Fairbanks]] (1996). He held various appointments at [[Syracuse University]], [[Bielefeld University]], [[Czech Academy of Sciences]], [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]], the [[University of the Witwatersrand]], and [[Stellenbosch University]]. He co-authored over 800 papers in mathematics with more than 350 co-authors.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.debrecensun.hu/uni/2026/08/05/internationally-renowned-mathematician-and-honorary-doctor-of-the-university-of-debrecen-florian-luca-dies-at-57/|title=Internationally renowned mathematician and honorary doctor of the University of Debrecen, Florian Luca, dies at 57|work=The Debrecen Sun|date=August 5, 2026|access-date=August 5, 2026}}</ref>

He was a recipient of the award of a 2005 [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] for Natural Sciences, Latin America & Caribbean.<ref>[http://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/florian-luca/ John Simon Guggenheim Foundation | Florian Luca], [[John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation]]</ref> In 2024 he received an [[European Research Council|ERC]] Synergy Grant and the next year he was awarded an [[Honorary degree|honorary doctorate]] by the [[University of Debrecen]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.debrecensun.hu/uni/2026/08/05/internationally-renowned-mathematician-and-honorary-doctor-of-the-university-of-debrecen-florian-luca-dies-at-57/|title=Internationally renowned mathematician and honorary doctor of the University of Debrecen, Florian Luca, dies at 57|work=The Debrecen Sun|date=August 5, 2026|access-date=August 5, 2026}}</ref>

He served as an [[editor-in-chief]] of ''[[Research in Number Theory]]'' <ref>[https://link.springer.com/journal/40993/editorial-board], [[Research in Number Theory]], Accessed September 20, 2024</ref> and ''INTEGERS: the Electronic Journal of Combinatorial Number Theory'',<ref>[http://www.integers-ejcnt.org/edboard.html Editorial Board], INTEGERS: the Electronic Journal of Combinatorial Number Theory. Accessed August 14, 2015</ref> and an editor of the ''[[Fibonacci Quarterly]]''.<ref>[http://www.fq.math.ca/editors.html Editorial Team], [[Fibonacci Quarterly]], Accessed August 14, 2015</ref>

== Selected works ==
* with Boris Adamczewski, Yann Bugeaud: Sur la complexité des nombres algébriques, [[Comptes rendus de l'Académie des Sciences|Comptes Rendus Mathématique. Académie des Sciences. Paris]]  339 (1), 11-14, 2013 
* with Kevin Ford, [[Carl Pomerance]]: Common values of the arithmetic functions Φ and σ, [[Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society]] 42 (3), 478-488, 2010
* with [[Jean-Marie De Koninck]]: Analytic Number Theory: Exploring the Anatomy of Integers, American Mathematical Society, 2012
* Diophantine Equations - Effective Methods for Diophantine Equations, 2009, [https://math.dartmouth.edu/archive/m105f12/public_html/lucaHungary1.pdf Online pdf file]
